outcome: identification and prevalence of high-risk factors complicating pregnancy and anesthesia care
cohort: 1000 randomly selected pregnant women attending Antenatal OPD at OBGY and preanesthetic room of Anesthesia Department RIMS, Adilabad.
finding: The study found that 93% of pregnant women had one or more high-risk factors, with anemia being the most common (86%) followed by previous caesarian section/instrumentation (17%) and pregnancy induced hypertension (12%).
mod_finding: 17% of the patients had a previous history of caesarian section or instrumentation.
